created.description: The creation date of the folder.

custom_tags.description: An array of custom tags for client application use.

items.description: A short client application defined tag.

favorite.description: True if the user has marked this folder a favorite.

folder_id.description: The folder id (in URN form).  Use the "folder_uri" uri template in the "templates" section of the discovery info to transform to a folder uri.

modified.description: The modification date of the folder.

parent_id.description: Folder id (in URN form) of the parent folder of this folder. If there is no parent (e.g. for a transient folder), this value is not present.

parent_uri.description: URI of the parent folder of this folder.  If there is no parent (e.g. for a transient folder), this value is not present.

source.description: Where the folder resides.  Currently either "native" or "creative_cloud"

starred.description: True if the user has starred this folder.
